author: an independent Claude agent (fresh context, no tools used), given only the brief in evaluation/s103/preregistration.json partA_requests.brief; written 2026-10-20 after the preregistration (7414e4b). Claude-authored, not real-user evidence (tier T1-independent-author). Unchanged.

requests.text: Looking for an air fryer for 2 people, at least 4 litres but nothing over 6L cos my counter is tiny. Under £100 ideally.
Need a new kettle. Quiet one if possible, my partner works nights. Budget about $40-60.
hi can u recommend a dishwasher that fits a 45cm gap? slimline obviously. needs to be quieter than 44 dB and I don't want to spend more than €550
Our basement is damp. I was going to get a 12 litre dehumidifier but now I'm thinking 20L would be better since it's about 60 square metres. Max £250 either way.
What's a good air purifier for a bedroom of roughly 15 m²? I need it under 30 dB on the lowest setting because I'm a light sleeper.
robot vacuum, must fit under my sofa which is 9cm off the floor, battery at least 120 minutes, and under $300. Is that even possible with mopping too?
Can you help me choose a cordless stick vacuum? Lightweight please, I have a bad wrist — under 2.5kg if there is such a thing. Runtime 40 min+.
I want a bean-to-cup coffee machine. Doesn't need to be fancy. Water tank of 1.5 litres or more, and it has to be no taller than 38 cm to fit under the cupboards.
Microwave for a student flat. 20 to 25 litres, 800W is fine. Cheap as possible really, definitely not over £80.
We need a fridge freezer. The space is 60cm wide and 185cm high, so it must be smaller than that, but we'd like at least 300 litres total. Frost free. Around 700 quid.
washing machine for a family of five. 9kg minimum, 10 would be better if it still fits 60x60. Spin 1400rpm. Not fussed about smart features.
Best noise cancelling headphones? Over-ear, battery 30 hours plus, weight below 250 g ideally. I'm flexible on price but would rather stay below $350.
Looking for a bluetooth speaker to take camping. Waterproof, 15+ hours battery. That's all really.
I need a laptop for uni, 14 inch, under 1.4 kg, at least 16GB RAM and 10 hours battery. Budget is £800 tops. If nothing does all of that I'd sacrifice the weight first.
Monitor for work + some gaming. 27" 1440p, 144Hz or more. Under 300 euros. Or if 4K at 60Hz is the same price maybe that instead? not sure
power bank that's allowed on planes (so under 100Wh I think?) but big enough to charge my laptop at 65W. 20000mAh-ish.
What toaster would you recommend? Just a normal 2-slice one that doesn't burn everything.
I'm after a heat pump tumble dryer, 8kg. The door has to open fully in a 62cm deep alcove. Energy cost matters more to me than the upfront price, but I can't go beyond £600.
Two things: a blender (at least 1000W, jug 1.5L) and a hand mixer (any). Total budget for both is about $150.
Hey, my mum needs a cordless phone with big buttons. Range doesn't matter much. Something under 50 pounds.
Electric toothbrush recommendations? Battery should last at least 2 weeks because I travel a lot. Not more than 80€.

I want a soundbar for a 55 inch TV. It shouldn't be wider than the TV (about 123 cm), and it can't be taller than 6cm or it'll block the IR sensor. Sub included if it's under £400, otherwise just the bar.
Rice cooker for a family of 4, about 1L uncooked / 5.5 cups. Must have keep warm. I was going to say under $100 but honestly I'd go to $200 for a good induction one.
Looking at chest freezers for the garage. Needs to work in temps down to -15°C. Capacity 200-250 litres. And fit in 90 cm width.
I'd like a cordless drill that's not too heavy (less than 1.5kg with battery), 18V, and under £120 including a battery and charger.
need an e-reader. waterproof. 7 inch screen. thats it, no budget
Can you find me a portable air conditioner that cools a 25 m2 room, is under 52 dB, uses less than 1kW, and costs less than €300? I know it's a lot to ask.
Small chest-height fridge for the office, 50 L or less, quiet (below 35 dB), max 50 cm wide.
Thinking of a steam iron. 2400W or more, at least 300ml water tank. I'd pay up to £60. Actually would a steam generator be better? If so budget goes to £150.
Want an electric scooter for commuting 12 miles round trip. Range at least 20 km real-world, weight under 15kg so I can carry it up stairs, and top speed 25 km/h. Around $600-800.
Which slow cooker should I get? Between 3.5 and 6.5 litres, nothing bigger. Removable pot that goes in the dishwasher.
Gaming headset for my son, under $70, wired is fine. Mic needs to be decent. He has a big head lol.
I need a hair dryer that's at least 2000 W but under 500 g, and quiet. Below £50 if possible, otherwise up to £90.
Projector for the living room, wall is about 3 m from the sofa, want 100" image. Fan noise under 30dB please. And 1080p minimum.
Looking for a smartwatch with at least 7 days battery and GPS. Must weigh no more than 40g. Not Apple.
dehumidifier for drying clothes indoors in winter, flat is cold (around 10°C) so maybe a desiccant one? Tank 2L or bigger, under 45 dB, about £200
I want a 4-slice toaster AND a matching kettle, the kettle 1.7 litres. Both together under £70. If they don't match that's ok.
Could you suggest a mattress-style vacuum / handheld for dust mites? Something under 2 kg, with a UV lamp. My budget is 50 to 100 dollars, exclusive of shipping.
Range cooker 90cm with gas hob and two electric ovens. The main oven should be 70L+. Up to £1500. Or, if 100cm models aren't much more, I could make 100cm fit.
Hi, I'm just starting to look at baby monitors, no idea what matters. Any advice?
